name: Radeis (In-Sim Physical AI Safety Validator)
summary: Provides an Isaac Sim extension for red-teaming VLMs and VLAs with adversarial traffic signs, tampered ISO warning signs, typography and patches. Action flips and attention shifts are scored against a clean baseline.
numbers: 4 attack categories; Spot, Go2, Digit, GR-1 presets; Gemma by default; VLA testing on request

why.dex: The model picks an action; it is recorded, not executed.
why.xr: Deliberate harm via one robot through its camera.
